evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Pragmatic and structured mindset, able to balance speed with reliability
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD explicitly balances speed ('lean and fast-paced environment') against reliability/quality signals ('ensure reliability and performance', 'Monitor data quality'), giving roughly equal weight to both.
evidence.domain_risk: You'll own and improve our data platform, keeping it fast, scalable, and trustworthy
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors affect ecommerce/subscription business decisions (MRR, churn, attribution) but there is no regulatory or financial-reporting language, placing it at moderate risk.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Maintain and develop our data architecture to ensure reliability and performance
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Named tools (Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran) appear directly in responsibilities and the role mentors a junior analyst, indicating an existing but still-growing data function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Build and maintain marketing attribution models across paid channels (Meta, Google, TikTok, affiliate)
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise metrics (MRR, churn, cohort retention, LTV, payback period) and specific channels, showing a hiring manager wrote it.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Collaborate across departments (Marketing, Finance, Operations) to connect data needs to solutions
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role serves commercial metrics (subscription/ecommerce, marketing attribution) and internal data platform ownership in roughly equal measure, so it is mixed.
evidence.autonomy_level: You'll own and improve our data platform, keeping it fast, scalable, and trustworthy
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role combines strategic ownership of the data platform with day-to-day execution translating business questions into dashboards.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No mention of AI tools or AI-consuming infrastructure anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Monitor data quality and proactively fix issues before they impact teams
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality is mentioned as a monitoring responsibility but without a named testing framework or ownership-of-standards framing, so tool_listed.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Monitor data quality and proactively fix issues before they impact teams
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Moderate: operational reliability of the data platform is a stated concern, but it is secondary to delivery and growth framing, not compliance or regulatory risk.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Maintain and develop our data architecture to ensure reliability and performance
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The JD mixes maintaining existing architecture with laying a 'rock-solid data foundation' for future growth, so mixed rather than purely greenfield or fix/scale.
